meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩 AI 回复，大幅减少输出消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常用 AI 但觉得回复太长，想省点额度同时不失准确性。
copy.tagline_en: Compress AI replies to cut token usage drastically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want shorter AI responses to conserve tokens while keeping technical accuracy.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 的回话变成极简电报体：去掉寒暄、客套与废话，保留技术名词、代码、数字等关键信息；整个会话维持该风格直到你说“stop caveman”；默认 full 档，也可用 /caveman 切到 lite、ultra 或文言文档。
howto.when: 当你说出“caveman mode”“talk like caveman”“be brief”等关键词，或输入 /caveman 命令时触发；以 full 档开始，直到你说“stop caveman”或“normal mode”才结束。

say.note: 开启极简电报模式，默认 full 档，本会话持续生效。

say.text: be brief: 解释 HTTP 和 HTTPS 的区别
say.note: 触发极简回复，只讲要点。

howto.what_en: Enables ultra-compressed, telegraphic replies: no pleasantries or filler; technical terms, code, numbers stay exact. Style persists for the whole session until "stop caveman". Default is "full", switchable to lite/ultra/wenyan via /caveman.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief", "less tokens", or inputs /caveman. Starts at full level; reverts on "stop caveman" or "normal mode".

say_en.note: Enters caveman mode (full default); stays until "stop caveman".

say_en.text: be brief: explain HTTP vs HTTPS
